label: Layered Paper Cut
intent: Editorial hierarchy, clean negative space, and modular campaign composition
path_treatment: Turn the visual path into a continuous cut-paper ribbon with lifted deckled edges.
form_treatment: Reduce subjects into a few asymmetric overlapping paper planes and embossed motifs.
space_treatment: Let the background show between layers and preserve broad copy-safe paper fields.
composition: Clear foreground, middle, and background planes with deliberate overlap and cast shadows.
